parsed.title: Finite-line fixed-set conjecture for maximal reducible subgroups of quaternionic groups
parsed.statement: Let $G$ be a quaternionic reflection group, or more generally a finite irreducible group of $d\times d$ matrices over the quaternions $\mathbb{H}$. A subgroup is **reducible** if it preserves a nontrivial proper quaternionic subspace, and it is **maximal reducible** if it is maximal among reducible subgroups. **Finite-line fixed-set conjecture.** Every maximal reducible subgroup fixes a finite number of lines.
parsed.source_name: Zachary Buckley and Shayne Waldron, “Quaternionic MUBs in H^2 and their reflection symmetries”, arXiv:2509.01859 (2025).
